name: Google Docs
_comment: client_id ships empty on purpose: Fused still has to publish a Google Cloud project with a Desktop OAuth client. Google's desktop clients must send their (non-secret, by Google's own docs) client_secret at the token endpoint, so a pack never ships one: FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_GOOGLE_DOCS_CLIENT_ID and FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_GOOGLE_DOCS_CLIENT_SECRET fill both at load, and Advanced on the card takes the id and secret of your own Desktop client (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials, with the Google Docs API and the Google Drive API enabled). A card of its own, apart from Gmail and Calendar, so connecting Docs grants nothing else. Both scopes are Google's sensitive tier (free brand review, no CASA): documents reads and edits any doc by id or URL; drive.file lists only the docs made through Fused. Whole-Drive search by name would need drive.metadata.readonly, a restricted scope, and is left out on purpose.
privacy: Sign-in and every call go straight from this computer to Google. The token stays on this computer. Fused runs no server in this flow.
